events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: It's 35 years since the legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away.

angles.name: Freddie's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, his stage presence, his sheer audacity – truly one of a kind.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album "Rubber Soul" in the UK on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal moment in music history, changing the game for album artistry.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, the world lost music icon John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Impact
angles.copy: Forty-six years since we said goodbye to John Lennon. His music and message continue to resonate across generations.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80

angles.name: Bowie's 80th
angles.copy: Imagining David Bowie at 80 today. An artist who continually redefined what was possible in music and culture. What's your favourite Bowie era?
